canonical_title: Cadence unveils Maestro domain-specialized models for agentic chip design
treatment: Announced 2026-10-26; do not re-report without model availability, weights/API details, independent reproducible EDA benchmark, pricing, security architecture or production deployment hard delta.
known_facts: Cadence officially introduced the Maestro domain-specialized model portfolio integrated with EDA/SDA tools and reinforcement learning using deterministic engineering feedback.

Official early design-workflow results claim up to 30% better quality of results and up to 5X greater token efficiency compared with general-purpose foundation models; independent methodology is not established.
Cadence says the solution can run in its cloud, public cloud, or customer-controlled on-premises environments; it uses NVIDIA Nemotron and is working with NVIDIA on OpenShell security integration.
First Maestro models are available only to select early-access customers in Q4 2026; not general availability. Reuters published 2026-10-26 13:03 UTC = 22:03 JST.
reinclude_only_if: Public API, weights, licensing, pricing, GA status or expanded early access becomes available.
Independent reproducible EDA results validate or refute vendor 30% and 5X claims.
Published OpenShell policy enforcement and model fine-tuning/data-boundary implementation details materially change deployment options.
notes: NEW in night window, official press release plus Reuters 22:03 JST. Early access, not general public model weights.
